fields: SHA256 complete canonical remaining identity fields
N1-LABEL-IR-ATOMICITY.canonical_encoding: Field order above, BE integers, u32 byte length then unnormalized strict UTF8, fixed32 hashes. ID preimage excludes LABEL_IDENTITY only, includes namespace/version. No NULL/extra fields. Size bounded by exact field sizes plus namespace length.
N1-LABEL-IR-ATOMICITY.publication_identity: SHA256(namespace UTF8 || complete canonical label bytes || u64 expected_previous_revision || bytes32 expected_previous_digest)
N1-LABEL-IR-ATOMICITY.store: Separate private label append journal owned solely by existing NATIVE_REGISTRY_WRITER actor10; HEALTH_GUARD actor8 has read-only descriptor and submits proposals, never writes. The four existing registry record schemas remain byte-identical. Label journal does not grant generation/publication authority or mutate registry revision. OS enforcement binding remains under N1-SCALAR-SYSCALL-IR.
N1-LABEL-IR-ATOMICITY.label_commit_record: Domain ASCII FLOOOW/P0090/R5N2/LABEL_COMMIT/V2 then u32 BE complete frame length; frame:u16 version2,u16 writer10,u16 observer8,u64 label_revision,u64 expected_previous_revision,bytes32 previous_label_digest,bytes32 observed_registry_tip_digest,u64 observed_registry_sequence,u32 label_length,complete label bytes,u16 state2(COMMITTED); Ed25519 signature64 over domain plus complete frame; trailer SHA256(frame||signature). Record revision starts1 with previous_revision0/previous_digest allzero under fresh independent HOST-approved context; never reset inside same context. Label max65536 bytes; no other record types accepted.
N1-LABEL-IR-ATOMICITY.CAS: NATIVE_REGISTRY_WRITER serializes both its registry and label writes under one owned lock. Compare expected previous label revision/digest, expected exact registry tip sequence/digest and current generation high water; require all equal and no pending registry transition. Append full label commit with next label_revision=previous+1 (overflow reject), checksum/signature and previous label digest; fsync label journal, require independent HEALTH_GUARD read-back receipt before eligibility. Release lock only after receipt or durable UNKNOWN quarantine. Consumers verify writer signature and guard receipt binding both exact tips, then revalidate current generation and registry tip at use; any registry advance invalidates label, no fallback. Missing writer/observer continuity => UNKNOWN. No fieldwise publication.

transitions.PREPARED: No authority. Full record validated but no commit receipt.
transitions.COMMITTED: Only after durable commit acknowledgment and complete chain/tuple validation.
transitions.REJECTED: Malformed/conflicting/unauthorized publication; cannot upgrade this identity.
transitions.UNKNOWN: Incomplete durability/chain/observer evidence; no authority until full independent recovery validates the same commit.

N1-LABEL-IR-ATOMICITY.duplicate: Same publication ID and byte-identical committed record => return same receipt, no new revision/use. Same ID different bytes or predecessor => REJECTED.
N1-LABEL-IR-ATOMICITY.partial: No complete frame/checksum/signature => UNKNOWN; never parse a valid prefix as label.

crashes.during: Incomplete frame => UNKNOWN; complete durable commit recoverable only under preserved journal recovery.
crashes.after: Committed chain is recovered; prior one-use consumption is retained, never reset.

N1-LABEL-IR-ATOMICITY.replay: Older generation/revision/context/work or consumed publication => REJECTED; exact duplicate receipt does not grant a second use.
N1-LABEL-IR-ATOMICITY.mismatch: Generation or registry mismatch => REJECTED. Unknown current high water => UNKNOWN. Both not qualified.
N1-LABEL-IR-ATOMICITY.future_verification: Measure installed label store/consumer policy identities, inject each state/crash/CAS mismatch into isolated future harness; require no accepted label before complete commit. No installed enforcement claimed.

N1-SCALAR-SYSCALL-IR.design_vs_measurement: 240 prior rows are candidate observations of requested operations, not an approved measured binary syscall set. Actual architecture numbers and concrete set are BUILD_PROOF_PENDING; missing argument/label decision algorithms remain static gaps.

operators.EQ_U64: Compare unsigned bits after exact target ABI decode.
operators.FD_IDENTITY: Kernel retained handle must match immutable per-slot handle label plus generation/context and no open-ended numeric-FD equality.
operators.AND: FALSE if any false; UNKNOWN if no false and any unknown; TRUE otherwise.
operators.UNKNOWN: Never issue operation; participant not qualified.

N1-SCALAR-SYSCALL-IR.translation: Future build emits manifest keyed by OS release/source digest, audit ABI, architecture, build ID, binary SHA256 and policy version. Resolve symbolic operation to syscall number only from pinned ABI table. Reject aliases, unknown numbers, multiplexed hidden operations or absent argument semantics. Compare measured reachable operations against closed IR; every operation must have exactly one rule; duplicates/unknown deny.
N1-SCALAR-SYSCALL-IR.static_gap: FD/path/socket/IPC race-safe kernel inspection and pointer predicates in prior rows still have no selected backend algorithm. A finite IR alone does not discharge these previous missing decisions.

N1-READER-PREPARSE-GATE.boundary_distinction: This revision adds byte gate BEFORE snapshot decoding. It does not replace the R5N.1 earliest SQL parse/type/planner effect gate; that original subcondition remains open under this same ID.
N1-READER-PREPARSE-GATE.source_identities: All six header digests must equal enrolled approved manifest values; no caller authority to choose expected values.
algorithm: Check fixed magic/version and complete fixed header length without allocation from claimed length.
Compare header identities/generation/context/revision against independent approved challenge; unknown expected identity => PREPARSE_UNKNOWN.
Check payload length equals remaining bytes and configured maxima; no trailing bytes.
Require exactly19 relation frames with source IDs from codec table, each exactly once in numeric ID order.
For each row validate declared exact field count, monotonically assigned tags, exact type IDs/null flags/lengths and source field set; reject duplicate/missing/unknown tags.
Reject duplicate natural row keys; enforce canonical row ordering and exact expected identity roster where supplied.
Validate every scalar/array using codec table before releasing any decoded row. Stage all rows privately until entire snapshot validates.
Only complete frame produces PREPARSE_ACCEPT and immutable decoded snapshot identity; no prefix rows enter graph.

results.PREPARSE_ACCEPT: All deterministic structural and independent identity checks true; not itself qualification.
results.PREPARSE_REJECT: Malformed, unsupported version, duplicate/unknown/missing field/relation, truncation, limit violation, unexpected extra bytes or identity mismatch.
results.PREPARSE_UNKNOWN: Required independent expected identity/version/currentness evidence unavailable; does not qualify.
